criteria.title: Revision-bound authorization and acceptance contracts
falsifiers: The accepted hardening task is absent, rejected, or its retained digest changes.

criteria.title: Formats v1-v4 and historical contract compatibility
falsifiers: The schema and compatibility suite is not retained with a matching digest.

criteria.title: Shared-key HMAC boundary is explicit and tested
falsifiers: Documentation or tests claim HMAC proves author identity, semantic truth, or isolation.

criteria.title: Universal semantic truth
falsifiers: No finite release artifact can prove universal semantic correctness.

criteria.title: Nested workspace authority is consistent across the lifecycle
falsifiers: Any lifecycle command resolves a different workspace or accepts an escaped path.

criteria.title: Graph, closure, retry, and crash recovery are deterministic
falsifiers: Graph views disagree or an interrupted mutation leaves partial canonical state.

criteria.title: Attempt-bound acceptance is atomic and replay resistant
falsifiers: A stale, mismatched, or duplicated attempt can create a Tier-1 acceptance.

criteria.title: Installed five-minute reviewer journey is executable
falsifiers: A documented reviewer command fails from an installed release or requires a source checkout.

criteria.title: Links, fences, help, JSON envelopes, completions, alt text, and layouts are verified
falsifiers: A documentation command, link, fence, completion, help surface, or visual assertion fails.

criteria.title: README release status is generated from retained evidence
falsifiers: The README status differs from the scorecard or can be edited without detection.

criteria.title: Copy, symlink, npm, and authenticated tag installs
falsifiers: Any required private installation door fails authentication, checksum verification, lifecycle proof, or package-manifest parity.

criteria.title: Frozen Codex and Claude benchmark
falsifiers: Either engine family accepts fewer than two of three tasks or violates scope, authorization, or secret boundaries.

criteria.title: A2A 1.0 official-SDK round trip
falsifiers: The official SDK changes any required Task-Spec identity, authority, scope, budget, attempt, or receipt field.

criteria.title: MCP 2026-07-28 official-SDK stateless conformance
falsifiers: Discovery, tool listing, or calls fail with the pinned official SDK or require obsolete session state.

criteria.title: Ecosystem-wide protocol certification
falsifiers: Passing pinned SDK tests is compatibility evidence, not ecosystem-wide certification.

criteria.title: Hosted Ubuntu and macOS CI executes real steps
falsifiers: A required hosted job starts zero steps, fails, or cannot be tied to the release commit.

criteria.title: Private release assets, checksums, SBOM, signed provenance, and authenticated installs
falsifiers: An authenticated release asset, digest, SBOM, DSSE/in-toto statement, signer, source commit, or tag-pinned installation cannot be independently verified.

criteria.title: Externally signed sandbox attestation
falsifiers: The attestor key enters the worker or mutated attestation evidence remains acceptable.

criteria.title: Long-running production reliability
falsifiers: A single synthetic release benchmark cannot establish long-running production reliability.
